title: Housing and city life
theme: owning and renting, neighbourhoods and urban problems
goal: Recognise and use 24 words and collocations for discussing housing, neighbourhoods and city problems in TEF and TCF tasks.

example.fr: Ils remboursent leur hypothèque depuis dix ans.
example.en: They have been paying off their mortgage for ten years.

example.fr: Avec les prix actuels, il est difficile de devenir propriétaire.
example.en: With today's prices, it is hard to become a homeowner.

example.fr: Ils ont acheté un appartement en copropriété.
example.en: They bought a condo.

example.fr: La colocation permet de payer un loyer moins cher.
example.en: Sharing a flat means paying less rent.

example.fr: La ville veut construire plus de logements sociaux.
example.en: The city wants to build more social housing.

example.fr: Le propriétaire a rénové la cuisine avant de louer l'appartement.
example.en: The landlord renovated the kitchen before renting the apartment.

example.fr: J'habite dans un quartier résidentiel très calme.
example.en: I live in a very quiet residential area.

items.en: the neighbours, the people living nearby

example.fr: Les fêtes bruyantes dérangent tout le voisinage.
example.en: Noisy parties bother all the neighbours.

example.fr: Les marchés publics animent la vie de quartier.
example.en: Public markets liven up neighbourhood life.

example.fr: Les familles recherchent des services de proximité : école, épicerie, clinique.
example.en: Families look for local services: school, grocery store, clinic.

example.fr: Une manifestation a eu lieu devant l'hôtel de ville.
example.en: A protest took place in front of city hall.

example.fr: Un bon urbanisme tient compte des piétons et des cyclistes.
example.en: Good urban planning takes pedestrians and cyclists into account.

example.fr: Les infrastructures de la ville sont vieillissantes.
example.en: The city's infrastructure is ageing.

example.fr: Beaucoup de citadins rêvent d'une maison à la campagne.
example.en: Many city dwellers dream of a house in the country.

example.fr: En milieu urbain, on peut souvent vivre sans voiture.
example.en: In urban areas, you can often live without a car.

example.fr: En milieu rural, les services sont parfois loin.
example.en: In rural areas, services are sometimes far away.

items.en: to commute (go back and forth regularly)

example.fr: Camille fait la navette entre Gatineau et Ottawa.
example.en: Camille commutes between Gatineau and Ottawa.

example.fr: Je suis resté une heure dans les embouteillages.
example.en: I was stuck in traffic jams for an hour.

example.fr: La pollution sonore nuit au sommeil des habitants.
example.en: Noise pollution harms residents' sleep.

example.fr: Les habitants se plaignent du manque de propreté des rues.
example.en: Residents complain that the streets are not clean.

example.fr: Un meilleur éclairage réduit le sentiment d'insécurité.
example.en: Better lighting reduces the feeling of being unsafe.

example.fr: La hausse des loyers aggrave l'itinérance.
example.en: Rising rents are making homelessness worse.

example.fr: Les refuges accueillent les sans-abri pendant l'hiver.
example.en: Shelters take in homeless people during the winter.

example.fr: L'embourgeoisement du quartier fait partir les anciens résidents.
example.en: The neighbourhood's gentrification is pushing out long-time residents.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body: In Québec, [[une hypothèque]] is the mortgage loan (France: [[un prêt immobilier]]), [[un condo]] is common for [[une copropriété]], and [[l'itinérance]] means homelessness (France: [[le sans-abrisme]], and people talk about [[les SDF]]). [[Sans-abri]] traditionally doesn't change in the plural: [[les sans-abri]]. [[Embouteillage]] and [[bouchon]] both mean a traffic jam. [[Le voisinage]] usually means the people around you.

blocks.note: Useful sentences for describing your city in a speaking task.

lines.en: The city wants to build more social housing.

lines.en: Camille commutes between Gatineau and Ottawa.

lines.en: I was stuck in traffic jams for an hour.

En milieu urbain, on peut souvent vivre sans voiture.
lines.en: In urban areas, you can often live without a car.

lines.fr: L'embourgeoisement du quartier fait partir les anciens résidents.
lines.en: The neighbourhood's gentrification is pushing out long-time residents.

blocks.prompt: Karim lives in Laval and works downtown in Montréal every day. What does he do?
blocks.explain: Faire la navette = to commute back and forth.
optionFeedback: Colocation is sharing a flat; you say vivre en colocation.
Voisinage is the people who live near you.

blocks.prompt: Which word completes: « La hausse des loyers aggrave ___. »
blocks.explain: Rising rents make homelessness (the situation) worse: l'itinérance.
optionFeedback: Sans-abri are the people; rents don't make people worse.

blocks.prompt: It is hard to become a homeowner.
accept: Il est difficile de devenir propriétaire.
blocks.explain: No article before propriétaire in devenir propriétaire.

blocks.prompt: The city wants to build more social housing.
accept: La ville veut construire plus de logements sociaux.
La ville veut construire davantage de logements sociaux.
La Ville veut construire plus de logements sociaux.
blocks.explain: Logement social → logements sociaux in the plural (-al → -aux).

blocks.text: Les familles recherchent des services de ___.
blocks.explain: Services de proximité = services close to home.

blocks.text: En milieu ___, les services sont parfois loin.
blocks.en: In rural areas, services are sometimes far away.
blocks.explain: Far-away services describe the countryside: le milieu rural.

blocks.fr: Ils ont acheté un appartement en copropriété.
blocks.explain: copropriété is one word; propriété has two é's (pro-pri-é-té).

blocks.fr: Les habitants se plaignent du manque de propreté des rues.
blocks.en: Residents complain that the streets are not clean.
blocks.explain: [[Le manque de propreté]] = a lack of cleanliness.

summary:
- Talk about owning and renting: [[l'hypothèque, devenir propriétaire, la colocation, le logement social]]
- Describe city life: [[la vie de quartier, les services de proximité, faire la navette]]
- Name urban problems: [[les embouteillages, la pollution sonore, l'itinérance, l'embourgeoisement]]

meta.notes: Replaced r4 (sans-abris is allowed by the 1990 spelling reform, so it had two defensible answers); fixed the propreté example (manque de propreté); removed wrong accepts (le bruit, co-propriété); added France equivalents (prêt immobilier, sans-abrisme, SDF) to accept and explain; corrected the voisinage note.
